title: a connector end names the inherited feature, not the outer one
note: FIXED 2026-09-03 (I4). `x` exists both in the enclosing package and in the supertype `Base`. The endpoint used to bind to the outer `P::x`. The inherited one wins now — and because a type-owned feature is shared by every usage of that type, the endpoint binds to a usage-scoped IMPLICIT mirror (`P::Car::x`) rather than to `Base::x` itself, which is what keeps two connectors on the same definition from collapsing into one edge.
